record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly reduce learning rate from 1e-3 to 5e-4, increase dropout from 0.2 to 0.3 and set weight decay to 1e-5. Smaller updates coupled with stronger regularization may reduce overfitting of tied embeddings under full-catalog cross-entropy. Retain width 64, two blocks, two heads, history length 128, batch size 128, existing Adam optimizer type, loss and readout. Keep seed 42, the 200-epoch cap and 200 batches per epoch.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four category models, couple a smaller learning rate with stronger dropout and weight decay to test whether gentler updates and regularization improve validation ranking under full-catalog cross-entropy. Preserve the existing Adam optimizer, architecture, loss, inference, seeds and training caps. Dropout is already passed explicitly during training; prediction disables dropout, so predictor and checkpoint shapes remain consistent.
